spanish: y pasare sobre él espíritu de celos, y celare a su mujer, y ella impurecida; o pasare sobre él espíritu de celos, y celare a su mujer, y ella no impurecida,

findings.issue: Qal and piel perfect 3ms are rendered as future subjunctive, smoothing aspect and mood.
Niphal perfect 3fs is a finite verb; impurecida is a passive resultative participle and narrows the niphal toward being made impure.

notes: Participants, repetition, negation, the construct, and the או alternative match the tokens.
